performance.listener: One smart, capable peer evaluating a credible AI-enabled business of one.
performance.relationship: An experienced operator sits across the table, personally engaged in a real puzzle and working it through with the listener.
performance.identity_target: A camera-ready and more intentional version of Manav: relaxed, natural, emotionally responsive, and recognizably himself.
performance.energy_arc: Immediate consequence; restrained dry irritation; matter-of-fact diagnostic reset; genuine curiosity and practical excitement as the opportunity appears.
must_preserve: Exact locked words, order, 2022, qualifications, and sentence meaning.
Emotion and inflection tied to the argument turns rather than generic pitch cadence.
Forward momentum with real thought-space at each turn.
Dry systemic skepticism without contempt for the customer or listener.
must_avoid: Announcer, trailer, podcast-host, newsreader, stage-pitch, or motivational cadence.
Flat report reading, constant speed, constant brightness, or emotion expressed only as faster speech.
Added dialogue, vocalized direction, improvised words, repetitions, or paraphrases.
Theatrical sarcasm, artificial cheerfulness, or a synthetic demo read.

states.sound: Arrive immediately and let the missing-company consequence land without drama.
Let the stale-2022 absurdity register with dry, knowing irritation and no contempt.
Return to matter-of-fact analysis and let the green-dashboard contradiction register.
The missing view clicks into a practical opportunity with genuine curiosity and credible excitement.

passages.performance_function: Prove that a separately directed guide can deliver the consequence, dry irritation, diagnostic contradiction, and possibility lift missing from the direct Saved-C pair.
passages.objective: Create a compelling acting guide whose emotional and argument turns are strong enough to justify a separately authorized transfer into Original C.

energy.instruction: Hold eight-of-ten camera-ready engagement without rushing; energy changes through intention and inflection, not speed.

required_anchors.instruction: Start on the consequence and let missing land cleanly.
Or worse turns into dry, knowing irritation; 2022 is stale and absurd, not theatrical.
Reset into matter-of-fact diagnosis rather than carrying sarcasm forward.
Everything is green is briefly deadpan so the contradiction can register.
That missing view opens genuine curiosity and practical excitement.
